Subject: correction on PR #1932 CI status

Correction to my earlier note: GitHub had not synced the PR head for the last two commits (BUG-1228 fix 56c2715dd3 and the review-round fix 78ec299dd1), so the "CI green" I reported covered only the first four. I have nudged the PR (empty commit) so CI runs on the real head; please wait for Build (ubuntu-latest) to pass on the current tip before merging. Everything else in the earlier mail stands.
